rows.line: Would have barred spending appropriated funds to withhold or cancel delivery of defense articles; the House passed it 224-187.
rows.rationale: Every operative section of the bill is a spend-what-was-appropriated instrument. Section 4 bars any funds appropriated to the Departments of Defense or State for fiscal year 2024 or earlier from being used "to withhold, halt, reverse, or cancel the delivery of defense articles or defense services", or to pay the salary of any officer or employee who acts to support such a withholding. Section 5 requires the Secretaries of Defense and State to ensure prompt delivery of articles supported by prior appropriations Acts and gives already-withheld items a 15-day deadline. Section 6 freezes the unobligated Operation and Maintenance, Defense-Wide balances for the immediate Office of the Secretary of Defense and the Diplomatic Programs balances for the Office of the Secretary of State until each Secretary certifies and reports to the Appropriations Committees that the deadline was met. Section 3(3) states the purpose in the same terms, calling on the administration "to utilize all congressionally appropriated funds ... as Congress intended". A yea compels obligation and delivery of appropriated assistance the executive had paused. This measure had been left off the checks-and-balances axis in the seed on the ground that a member forcing out the paused shipments was voting about Israel; that was a reading of motive rather than of the instrument, and it predates the August 2026 split that created this mechanism key. Weighted at 60 rather than at the primary because the compulsion runs to one partner's arms transfers rather than to appropriations practice generally.

rows.line: Would restructure individual and small-group health-coverage rules; the House passed it 216-211.
rows.rationale: A broad restructuring of individual and small-group health-coverage rules. Primary: the coverage rules are the bill's own operative text — which individual and small-group plans may be sold, on what terms, and with what pharmacy-benefit-manager transparency — so the healthcare relation is the instrument's subject rather than a by-product of a vehicle carrying other cargo; every one of this measure's four mappings is a health key. Weighted 70 rather than 100 because healthcare_costs carries the larger share and outranks it; the weight is what ranks the axes.

H.R. 8369|118.title: Israel Security Assistance Support Act

Introduced after the administration paused a shipment of 2,000-pound and 500-pound bombs. Passed the House 224-187 on 2024-05-16; the Senate did not take it up.

issues.rationale: Requires the President to deliver to Israel the defense articles and services Congress has already authorized and appropriated, and withholds salaries-and-expenses funding from the Office of the Secretary of Defense, the Office of the Secretary of State and the National Security Council until the withheld shipments go out. Introduced after the administration paused a shipment of 2,000-pound and 500-pound bombs. A yea forces the transfer.

Every operative section of the bill is a spend-what-was-appropriated instrument. Section 4 bars any funds appropriated to the Departments of Defense or State for fiscal year 2024 or earlier from being used "to withhold, halt, reverse, or cancel the delivery of defense articles or defense services", or to pay the salary of any officer or employee who acts to support such a withholding. Section 5 requires the Secretaries of Defense and State to ensure prompt delivery of articles supported by prior appropriations Acts and gives already-withheld items a 15-day deadline. Section 6 freezes the unobligated Operation and Maintenance, Defense-Wide balances for the immediate Office of the Secretary of Defense and the Diplomatic Programs balances for the Office of the Secretary of State until each Secretary certifies and reports to the Appropriations Committees that the deadline was met. Section 3(3) states the purpose in the same terms, calling on the administration "to utilize all congressionally appropriated funds ... as Congress intended". A yea compels obligation and delivery of appropriated assistance the executive had paused. This measure had been left off the checks-and-balances axis in the seed on the ground that a member forcing out the paused shipments was voting about Israel; that was a reading of motive rather than of the instrument, and it predates the August 2026 split that created this mechanism key. Weighted at 60 rather than at the primary because the compulsion runs to one partner's arms transfers rather than to appropriations practice generally.
